LESSON: DRIVING TOOLS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Production
Topic 4.2: Driving Tools
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Driving Tools, part of Tools and Production in Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How are driving tools used in day- to-day life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use visual aids or realia to identify driving tools in the community,

2. discuss uses of driving tools for different tasks (hammer, screwdriver, spanner, punches, mallets),

3. use print or digital devices to search and watch a video clip on the safe use of driving tools,

4. demonstrate safe use of driving tools to perform different types of tasks,

5. clean and safely store driving tools,

6. share experiences on the use of holding tools.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use visual aids or realia to identify driving tools in the community,
2. discuss uses of driving tools for different tasks (hammer, screwdriver, spanner, punches, mallets),
3. use print or digital devices to search and watch a video clip on the safe use of driving tools,
4. demonstrate safe use of driving tools to perform different types of tasks,
5. clean and safely store driving tools,
6. share experiences on the use of holding tools.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Driving Tools together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy: learner acquires self-awareness skills when demonstrating safe use of driving tools to perform different

types of tasks.

• Digital Literacy: learner enhances interacting with technology skills when searching for information on safe use of driving

tools.

21

Values:
• Respect: learner accommodates diverse opinions when sharing experiences on the use of holding tools.

• Peace: learner follows laid down procedures when demonstrating safe use of driving tools.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Personal Safety and Security: learner demonstrates basic safety skills when using driving tools safely to perform tasks.

Link to other Subjects:

Agriculture: learner enhances the knowledge on use of farm tools during demonstration on how to use and care for driving

tools.
